task.title: Description-based worker contract RED
task.description: Add a small meaningful regression test using existing contract validator for a task-implementer input with workspace codebase_path/branch and no issue_number. It must fail current schema. Positive legacy issue-backed requests must still pass and invalid supplied issue_number zero/negative/string/null must fail. Cover bundled+local schema parity. Only new test file src/gdskills/task-implementer-description.test.ts plus your T14 artifacts; no production changes.

acceptance_criteria: Issue-free description task accepted; issue-backed remains accepted; invalid supplied issue_number or missing path/branch refused.
constraints: Use local tests-creator skill and testing context; graph/wiki before deeper reads, keryx ctx rg only for code search.
Only write lane-owned tests and artifacts. No implementation code. No commits/staging/checkout/push; parent owns git.
Do not edit flow.json or frozen acceptance criteria; parent owns all flow transitions.
commit_test_stubs=false: shared feature branch with simultaneous workers.
Stats disabled; no external model calls, no private dataset copying.
Do not modify unrelated files. Coordinate shared test file ownership before edits.
Return STATUS first and validate subagent-result; persist RED command/output and test_case_specs in artifacts.
